units.source_text: 可是，这时候的火车已经平安驶出隧道，经过枯草山岭中凋敝城郊的道路岔道。

en.t: But by then the train had already come safely out of the tunnel and was passing a railroad crossing on the edge of a bleak town among hills of withered grass.

units.source_text: 道路岔道旁边，简陋的茅草屋顶和瓦房密密麻麻的排列着。

en.t: Beside the crossing, crude thatched roofs and tile-roofed houses stood packed closely together.

units.source_text: 约莫是扳道夫正在打信号吧，一面陈旧的白旗在空中摇曳。

en.t: Perhaps the switchman was signaling, for an old white flag was waving in the air.

units.source_text: 火车才驶出隧道，就在这个时候，我看见道岔的栅栏后面，

en.t: Just after the train came out of the tunnel, at that very moment, I saw behind the fence by the switch,

units.source_text: 有三个男孩子并肩站在一起，三个人的脸蛋红扑扑的。

en.t: three boys standing shoulder to shoulder, all three of their cheeks flushed red.

units.source_text: 他们个子都不高，就像是被低沉的天空压的。

en.t: None of them was tall; they looked as if they had been pressed down by the low-hanging sky.

units.source_text: 深山的衣服颜色，跟镇郊荒凉的景物一样惨淡。

en.t: The colors of their mountain-country clothes were as dreary as the desolate scenery on the town outskirts.

units.source_text: 他们一起抬头远望火车经过，齐齐举起手，

en.t: They all looked up together and gazed at the passing train from a distance, raising their hands in unison,

units.source_text: 扯着嗓子尖叫，听不明白喊得到底是什么意思。

en.t: and shrieked at the tops of their voices, though I could not make out what they were shouting.

units.source_text: 这一刹那，把头伸向窗外的姑娘，伸开满是冻疮的手，

en.t: At that instant, the girl who had thrust her head out the window stretched out her frostbitten hands,

units.source_text: 左右摇摆，令温暖的阳光映照成令人欢喜的金色的五六个橘子，

en.t: waved them from side to side, and five or six oranges, turned a joyful gold by the warm sunlight,

units.source_text: 突然从窗口往目送火车离开的孩子们头上落下。

en.t: suddenly fell from the window toward the heads of the children watching the train depart.

units.source_text: 我情不自禁的屏住呼吸，立刻了然。

en.t: I held my breath without meaning to, and at once I understood.

units.source_text: 约莫是姑娘要去当女佣，从窗口扔出去几个揣在怀里的橘子，

en.t: The girl was probably going away to work as a maid, and had thrown a few oranges she had tucked inside her coat out the window,

units.source_text: 犒劳专门来岔道旁送别她的弟弟们。

en.t: as a treat for her younger brothers, who had come all the way to the crossing to see her off.
